english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the part or point between two ends, including a middle point in time.
This is the all-purpose choice for a literal or metaphorical place in the middle.
Use 中間 as the all-purpose noun for a literal middle point or degree, including a compromise.

examples.english: I'm in the middle of the movie, and I need to go to the toilet.
examples.traditional: 套戲睇到中間，我要去廁所。
